title: Chapter 786
paragraphs: Chapter 786
Episode 193. The Childless (4)
"Manipulation?"
"Yeah, as soon as Sanna finished her first prayer, records started to be collected all at once. The interference on the battlefield suddenly disappeared."
Valeria opened the record window.
<Lokia Ganesto rescues Kelliark Zipple on the brink of annihilation and escapes the Tower of Stories.>
<'It can't end here, Kelliark Zipple. You must become complete and face Chiron.'>
These two sentences were clearly displayed in the record window.

"The record about Lokia, which we got in the A-space of Luntia, didn't stay like this but rather showed an unstable scattering. It could be because of the historical manipulation applied to Lokia, or it could be because Lokia did something."
"But there's no problem with the record about Lokia that we got this time……?"

"That's right. Sanna interfered. And in my opinion, Sanna thinks I didn't notice it. If I didn't see the end of the prayer myself, or if I didn't notice the instability of Lokia's record before, I wouldn't be sure."
What Sanna intervened with wasn't the record magic, but the records that were left on the spot.
If she had interfered with the record magic, Valeria couldn't have not felt it, but if she changed the record itself, Valeria couldn't notice it. Her record magic is not yet perfect.
As Valeria explained this, her colleagues nodded their heads.

"Sanna expected us to come and was manipulating the records, and fortunately, we arrived at the exact moment the record was manipulated and were able to identify it. Sanna failed to reproduce the unique instability of Lokia's record."
"That's right, Jin."
"So, isn't the possibility of Sanna and Lokia Ganesto being the same person decreased?"
Syris said.
As she said, if Sanna and Lokia were the same person, there would be no need to manipulate the record this way. Lokia could have done it herself, just like what she did in Luntia's A-space.

Mort breathed heavily. A while later, the group arrived at the Tikan Palace Garden, and the meeting started immediately. Lereat in the Garden of Swords and Ielo on Honka Island were also able to participate in the meeting through a communication device.
For a while, Valeria shared the information they had obtained from the Tower of Stories with her colleagues.
"……That's all."

{[Good job, Valeria. After listening to your explanation, it seems there are three main points. Firstly, the truth about Kelliark's rampage and his whereabouts, secondly, the relationship between Zipple, Sanna, and Lokia and Sanna, and thirdly, the reason for the manipulation and the enemies' objectives.]}
As Lereat spoke, the discussion about Kelliark's rampage began.
Most of the colleagues, including Jin, showed skeptical reactions to the question, 'Did Kelliark Zipple truly seek the power of the evil deity?'
"There were no particular signs from Kelliark until now. We might have failed to notice, but this is the first time a rampage and battle have occurred in the Tower of Stories."

"That's correct, Duke. It's nonsensical to suggest that the family wanted to turn Kelliark into an evil deity. That power is uncontrollable, and it has already been defeated by the temporary alliance. Especially, Duke Jin's God Fusion was the most impactful, so there's no reason for Zipple to be tempted."
The power of the evil deity is a catastrophe that can lead the world to destruction.
However, it was only a short while ago that it was defeated by the large forces and Jin. For Zipple to gain absolute dominance, they need a power greater than that of the evil deity.
Moreover, they have the Devil's Stone. Rather than gaining the power of the evil deity, completing the Devil's Stone seemed to align more with Zipple's objectives.
"Becoming an evil deity also requires the power of Helrum. However, unlike the prophet, Sanna, the childless woman, uses the power of the Sun God."
"Then... Kelliark's rampage could have been Veradin's operation for purging."
Quicantel's words drew everyone's attention.
"Veradin Zipple manipulated everything to purge Kelliark and seize absolute power within the family...?"
"If Veradin had been provoking Kadun to remove his influence deliberately, Kadun's recent actions could also be evidence."

"There are many reasons for purging. If Kelliark was in a non-recoverable state, ousting him would solidify Veradin's power. Even if Kelliark had to be killed because he went on a rampage, it would be better to frame him and let Veradin handle it."
Soon, Jin met the eyes of his colleagues and finished his thought.

"…Or, just like with the evil deity, it could be the result of some trickery by Lokia Ganesto. Either way, it's clear that Kelliark has fallen. Finding him and asking directly would be the most certain way."

"As the Duke suggests, we should find Kelliark. If Sanna's record is manipulated, there might not be anyone who helped Kelliark escape. In that case, he would have escaped on his own and is hiding somewhere."
Regardless of the reason for Kelliark's purge, Veradin is now the head of Zipple. Kelliark's era has completely ended.
And Jin felt it instinctively.
Fighting with his friend, who has become strange, would be harder than dealing with Kelliark.
Powers similar to record magic, a stronger Masin Stone, the presence of holy lands and the bio-golems of mages located there.
In fact, the abilities shown by Veradin, leading Zipple as a hand again, were far more threatening than in the days of Kelliark.

{[Finding Kelliark is something that Valeria will have to take on. Even if he didn't become a Fiend, it's a fact that he went berserk with his soul, so he can't hide for long. With that kind of soul, he's bound to be exposed somewhere. We must find him before Zipple does to know the truth.]}
"Understood, Lord Let."
{[I will also try hard to deduce the information about the record manipulation.]}

"Now let's talk about Sanna, the shaman. She appeared out of nowhere, not hiding her power of the sun at all. She also revealed that there are multiple sects within the Solar Church, and showed the ability to manipulate records."
"And when Jin asked if you are trying to resurrect the Sun God after first destroying the world, she was silent for a moment."
This time, Syris added his opinion to Jin's words.

"All along, followers of the Sun God, including Orgal, have claimed that when the Sun God resurrects, the world will be complete again. So, Sanna could plan to completely destroy the world and then resurrect the Sun God. After all, even if the world is destroyed, it will be complete again when the Sun God returns."
If Syris's hypothesis is true, the difference in position between Kinzelo and Sanna is a plausible issue.
Kinzelo wants to transform the world while preserving it, and Sanna wants to start all over again.
"If we assume what Lord Syris said, the destruction of the world may be a prerequisite for the resurrection of the Sun God. At least, Sanna's sect might think so."

"Then, wouldn't that explain why Sanna is with Zipple and not Kinzelo? She's using Zipple to first destroy the world! Using elements like the Masin Stone and Elona Zipple, who Misha is currently sealing."
When Enya spoke, the eyes of her colleagues widened.
It was just a hypothesis, but everyone felt a chilling sensation.

"But if the destruction of the world is a prerequisite for the resurrection of the Sun God, Sanna and Lokia overlap. After all, Lokia is the person assumed to have encouraged Rosa to become a fiend from behind."

"Regardless of what assumptions we make, the possibility that Lokia and Sanna are on the same side remains open. The reason why the manipulated records did not destabilize this time could be because Lokia, who is working with Sanna, could only have been absent."
At Valeria's opinion, her colleagues nodded their heads.
Sanna, Lokia, Kinzelo.
These three, even though they pursued different directions, shared the same goal. This means that they could combine their forces at any moment if the crucial time to resurrect the Sun God came.
{[Sir Bale, do you know anything about the Solar Church or its sects?]}
"No, I don't. It's quite annoying that this person named Sanna might have stronger powers than me."
{[Try to be a bit more helpful.]}
"Alright... I'm sorry."

"Hmm, anyway, based on the assumptions we've made so far... it seems likely that Zipple and Sanna are using each other. Zipple for the completion of the Masin Stone and bio-golems, and Sanna for the resurrection of the Sun God."
"It's a similar situation to when Kinzelo and Zipple were allies in the past."
"Just like then, we have no choice but to play them against each other. We need to make sure that neither achieves what they want."
The completion of the Masin Stone and the resurrection of the Sun God, the enemies' goals were clear.
For a while, similar assumptions to those discussed in the meeting were thrown around.
In a situation where only assumptions could be made without a conclusion, it was necessary to meet a person with the most certain knowledge about the Solar Church and Lokia.
"We must meet Orgal, your majesty. He definitely knows Sanna. If we go straight to him like last time, it will cause a fuss, so please send a letter immediately."
"Understood, minister."
Just as they were about to wrap up the meeting,
A hurried sound of footsteps came from the corridor. It was Jett running.
"Jett?"
"Master! Kelliark! Kelliark's Zipple!"
As soon as Jett entered the meeting room, he mentioned the name of Kelliark with a surprised look on his face.
"What did you say?"
"A person from Kelliark Zipple is at Tikan right now! He says he has something important to tell the lord... I thought he was just a madman, but he showed the seal of fire!"
"....Bring him here quickly!"
